title: Stable patterns on permutations of multisets
summary: In this paper, we study patterns on permutations of multisets whose multivariate distribution generating functions are symmetric. We interpret this phenomenon through the lens of group actions and define such a pattern as stable. Although various stability results are already implicit in existing enumerative work, we explicitly summarize them here and provide bijective proofs. These bijections offer new combinatorial insight into the symmetry of the generating functions. We also establish instability results.
